avoid_supplements.name: Allopurinol
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Inhibits xanthine oxidase, significantly increasing azathioprine metabolite accumulation and toxicity risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; if required, reduce azathioprine dose by 60-75% and monitor closely for myelosuppression

avoid_supplements.name: Febuxostat
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Xanthine oxidase inhibitor that increases active azathioprine metabolite levels
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or use alternative urate-lowering therapy; monitor CBC if concurrent use necessary

avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Immunostimulant that may antagonize azathioprine's immunosuppressive effects
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue use; may reduce drug efficacy in transplant and autoimmune conditions

caution_supplements.name: Folate/Folic acid
caution_supplements.mechanism: Azathioprine interferes with folate metabolism; supplementation may help mitigate hematologic toxicity
caution_supplements.action: Consider supplementation (5mg daily) under provider supervision; monitor CBC

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: May modulate immune response during immunosuppression; generally safe but effects unpredictable
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously; monitor for infection signs and discuss with prescriber

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may alter azathioprine metabolite levels variably
avoid_foods.action: Avoid consumption; use alternative citrus fruits if preferred

caution_foods.name: High-purine foods (organ meats, anchovies, sardines)
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase uric acid levels in patients with azathioprine-related hyperuricemia
caution_foods.action: Moderate intake; maintain adequate hydration and monitor uric acid levels

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: May potentiate hepatotoxicity and myelosuppression risks associated with azathioprine
caution_foods.action: Limit or avoid alcohol; discuss safe consumption limits with provider

monitoring_notes: TPMT genotyping is recommended before azathioprine initiation to identify poor metabolizers at high toxicity risk. Monitor CBC, liver function tests, and signs of infection regularly; baseline and periodic assessments are essential due to myelosuppression and malignancy risks.
